projects.title: FeedBook - Full-Stack Review Platform
projects.bodyText:
- Built a full-stack review platform with fuzzy search, category navigation, and an AI chatbot.
 - Designed a **9-table PostgreSQL** schema with triggers and threaded replies using self-referencing foreign keys.
 - Implemented **JWT**, OTP, BCrypt, token rotation, and **Spring Security RBAC**.
 - Developed layered **Spring Boot** REST APIs and a role-gated **React** frontend.

projects.title: MangaNest - Android Manga & Manhwa Reader
projects.bodyText:
- Built an Android manga reader with **AniList GraphQL**, OAuth 2.0, profiles, and reading sync.
 - Developed multi-source content extraction using **Jsoup** with fallback parsing.
 - Built a RecyclerView reader with **Glide** caching, image preloading, and persistent progress.
 - Implemented search, trending discovery, and Material Design UI.
